text:
alex: Heads up — after last driver hotpatch to 526.20 some nodes are showing scrambled PCI slot -> GPU UUID mappings and several MIG profiles disappeared. Noticed on eu2 and usw1 cohorts.

priya: which hosts? can you paste nvidia-smi output?

alex: gpu-eu2-03, gpu-eu2-07, gpu-usw1-11
alex: here's what I grabbed quickly:
```
$ ssh gpu-eu2-03 sudo nvidia-smi -L
GPU 0: A100-SXM (UUID: GPU-aaaa1111)
GPU 1: A100-SXM (UUID: GPU-bbbb2222)
# but PCI ordering shows gpu1 on slot 0000:3e:00.0 previously that was GPU-cccc3333
```

alex: and `nvidia-smi mig -lgi` shows zero MIG instances on some gpus that previously had 7g.20 profiles.

jamie: we pushed kernel 5.15.0-80 and NCCL patch earlier to those nodes — driver rollout infra-bot reported success (526.20). Could be PCI reorder during driver/kmod load causing the id mapping to shift.

infra-bot: driver-rollout v526.20 finished for eu2 cohort at 1991234400 :rocket:

priya: ok — first things: avoid brute force profile reapply until we know whether it's just an ID shuffle. If UUIDs moved, reapplying by index could attach to wrong physical GPU.

jamie: run these checks on an affected node:
```
# dump PCI topology and NVML device uuids
nvidia-smi topo -m
nvidia-smi -q | grep -A3 "GPU UUID"
lspci -nnk | grep -i nvidia -A3
```

jamie: also check /var/log/nvidia-installer.log and dmesg for kernel module binding errors.

alex: I restarted nvidia-persistenced and that fixed mapping on gpu-eu2-07 (MIG profiles reappeared) but gpu-eu2-03 still shows profiles missing and two GPUs report the same UUID in `nvidia-smi -L` (duplicate UUID).

mig-manager: duplicate UUIDs are bad — likely NVML returned stale mapping after kmod reload. Suggest running `sudo systemctl restart nvidia-mig-manager` and then `sudo nvidia-smi mig -r` to reload MIG config from /etc/nvidia/mig` (note: can disrupt workloads).

priya: agreed. Proposed mitigation plan:
1) cordon affected nodes and move GPU-critical pods to healthy nodes.
2) run debug commands, capture nvml logs.
3) restart nvidia-mig-manager on one node as test.
4) if successful, roll the restart in small waves (2 nodes at a time).
5) if restart doesn't help, rollback driver to 525.x on worst nodes and open vendor ticket.

sre-oncall: we need capacity buffer before cordoning — can we spin up 3 extra dedicated GPU hosts in eu2 for a few hours? tagging and autoscaling may be needed. Also open a status page note.

alex: starting scale-up now, creating temp pool `eu2-hotfix-3x` and will route sched to it.

jamie: add these debug envs if we restart MIG manager: `export NVIDIA_MIG_MANAGER_LOGLEVEL=debug` then `systemctl restart nvidia-mig-manager` — capture /var/log/syslog and /var/log/nvidia-mig-manager.log.

priya: quick commands for the runbook (for whoever runs it):
```
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
ssh <node>
sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced
sudo systemctl restart nvidia-mig-manager
sudo nvidia-smi mig -r
sudo nvidia-smi -L && sudo nvidia-smi mig -lgi
# gather logs
sudo tar czf /tmp/mig-debug-$(hostname).tgz /var/log/nvidia* /var/log/syslog
```

alex: ran restart on eu2-07 earlier, logs attached in thread (tl;dr: MIG instances returned). I'll test on eu2-03 next but wanted to flag duplicate UUID case to avoid blindly reapplying profile JSONs.

sre-oncall: approved rollback if restart fails. Go ahead but coordinate a 30m maintenance window for each node and update infra status page. :white_check_mark:

mig-manager: if you do rollback, collect `modinfo nvidia` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` before and after, and include nvml logs when filing vendor ticket.

alex: plan: roll restart in waves starting with eu2-03 test, if still broken we'll rollback driver on eu2-03/11/14 (worst offenders) tonight at 02:00 UTC. I'll post updates here.

infra-bot: incident created INC-2026-342 (priority P2) — link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-342

jamie: one more note — if the issue is PCI slot ordering change, it can persist across reboots until BIOS/firmware normalizes. Capture lspci output pre/post as well.

alex: noted, collecting everything. will update after eu2-03 test.
